meta.title: Task folding
meta.description: Open and close units of work with task_begin and task_end; each closed task records its summary and fold verdict in the session log.

client.dock.label: Open and recently folded tasks
client.settings.label: Task folding settings
client.settings.unavailable: Task folding settings are not available in this deployment.
client.settings.readOnly: This deployment keeps plugin settings read-only.
client.settings.notSaved: The Host did not accept that value.
client.settings.fields.minSpanTokens.label: Minimum fold size
client.settings.fields.minSpanTokens.descriptio: A closed task smaller than this many tokens is never folded.
client.settings.fields.delegateEnabled.label: Automatic summaries
client.settings.fields.delegateEnabled.descript: Summarize a task automatically when its own summary is missing or unusable.
client.settings.fields.minSummaryChars.label: Minimum summary length
client.settings.fields.minSummaryChars.descript: A task summary shorter than this is treated as missing.
client.settings.fields.maxSummaryRatio.label: Maximum summary share
client.settings.fields.maxSummaryRatio.descript: A task summary larger than this share of the task is treated as unusable.
client.settings.fields.staleTaskSteps.label: Stale-task reminder
client.settings.fields.staleTaskSteps.descripti: Remind the model about a task that stays open for this many steps.
client.settings.fields.showTaskBar.label: Task bar
client.settings.fields.showTaskBar.description: Show open and folding tasks above the composer.
client.settings.fields.summarizationProvider.de: Provider for automatic summaries; empty uses the session route.
client.settings.fields.summarizationModel.label: Summary model
client.settings.fields.summarizationModel.descr: Model for automatic summaries; set together with the provider.
